tasks.label: Docker: Build and save media-audit
args: if ! systemctl is-active --quiet docker; then echo 'Docker service is inactive; starting it...'; sudo systemctl start docker || exit $?; fi; docker info >/dev/null || { echo 'Docker daemon is still unavailable.' >&2; exit 1; }; docker compose build media-audit && docker save -o media-audit.tar media-audit:latest
